mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, we are seeing 65 degrees with clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. The Moon is currently a Waxing Gibbous, and you can catch a glimpse of the International Space Station tonight at 5:49 PM as it rises over Verona High School and travels toward the Madison area.

The City of Verona has announced that municipal buildings will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27. Additionally, residents should note that refuse and recycling pickup scheduled for Thursday will be pushed to Friday, and the Recycling Center on Investment Court will be closed for the duration of the holiday.

There is a great lineup of local entertainment today with live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can enjoy pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee on November 25, followed by trivia night at The Bogey Factory on November 26.
In a report regarding service calls from November 1 to 15, on November 2, officers were dispatched to West End Circle where a 48-year-old Verona man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Crazy for Cookie Dough. Culver's is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM, so stop by soon to get your fix.
